<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> was introduced in [[Game of Crone]] DLC. It can hold 12 items in it, effectively increasing your inventory size. It has also smaller version: [[Universal bag]].
You cannot put one bag inside another bag. 
[[Teleportstone]] cannot be placed inside a bag. 
One bag and [[Recipe: Big universal bag|recipe]] for it is rewarded upon completing the [[Refugee camp|refugee camp]] quest line with [[Marquis Teodoro Jr.]]
